title: xgboost-rs gpu oracle
_comment_machine_shape: T4 (SM 7.5), NOT the P100 (SM 6.0) Kaggle hands out by default. XGBoost's own 3.x wheels are built for SM70+, so on a P100 every XGBoost CUDA path dies with 'This program was not compiled for SM 60' — no gpu_hist baseline and no GPU-gated oracle fixtures. `enable_gpu` is deprecated and cannot choose a type; `machine_shape` can. Accepted values: NvidiaTeslaT4, NvidiaTeslaP100, Tpu1VmV38.
